Dear KeHE Deductions,

This is to inform you that we dispute claim R-0000445, which was taken on 2015-01-30. The amount in dispute is $376.10. According to our records, the correct spoils allowance for this store and period is $338.83 (0.0100 of $33,882.84 invoiced). Therefore, the amount to repay is $37.27. The dispute deadline was 2015-07-29, and this deadline has passed.

We hope to resolve this matter promptly. Please contact us at your earliest convenience.

Sincerely,

Northfield Pantry Co.
